Create apps/flashcards/docs/what/product-spec.md using template .oneticket/templates/product-spec.md.

Product name: Flashcard App
Tagline/summary: A flashcard learning app for world capitals with flip mode and session scoring.

Problem: People want to learn world capitals efficiently but lack a simple, engaging tool.
Target users: Students and lifelong learners studying geography.

Main capabilities for V1:
1. Display flashcards from a built-in World Capitals theme (195 countries)
2. Flip mode: tap/click card to reveal answer (capital) from question (country)
3. Track session progress with "I knew it" / "I didn't know" buttons
4. End-of-session results screen with score summary and replay option
5. Theme selector on home screen (structure ready for more themes)
6. Learning mode selector on home screen (flip only, structure ready for spaced-repetition)

Key types:
- LearningMode = 'flip' | 'spaced-repetition'
- Theme { id, name, cards: Card[] }
- Card { id, front, back }
- SessionResult { cardId, known: boolean, timestamp }

Screens:
- Home (/): theme picker + learning mode selector + Start button
- Session (/session): centered card, flip on tap/click, progress bar, I knew it / I didn't know buttons
- Results (/results): score summary, replay button

Constraints:
- No backend — MSW + localStorage only
- React + Vite + TypeScript stack
- AppShell as scaffold base
- Learning mode logic isolated in a hook (algo never hardcoded in components)
- GitHub Pages deployment

Data: src/data/themes/world-capitals.json — format { id, front: "France", back: "Paris" }

AppShell adaptations:
- Keep: Home, About
- Remove: Help nav link
- Remove: DemoScreen (/demo), HelpScreen (/help)

Use the template and fill in all sections. Include `title:` frontmatter.

--- US-001: Home Screen ---
Title: Home screen with theme and mode selection
As a user, I want to select a theme and learning mode on the home screen, so that I can start a study session tailored to my needs.

Acceptance criteria (Gherkin):
- Given I am on the home screen (/)
- When the page loads
- Then I see a theme picker with "World Capitals" selected by default
- And I see a learning mode selector with "Flip" selected by default
- And I see a "Start" button
- When I tap Start
- Then I navigate to /session

--- US-002: Flashcard Session ---
Title: Flashcard session with flip and scoring
As a user, I want to see a flashcard, flip it to reveal the answer, and indicate whether I knew it, so that I can study effectively.

Acceptance criteria (Gherkin):
- Given I am on /session
- When the page loads
- Then I see a progress bar showing current card / total cards
- And I see the card question (country name) centered on screen
- When I tap/click the card
- Then the card flips to reveal the answer (capital)
- When the answer is visible
- Then I see "I knew it" and "I didn't know" buttons
- When I tap "I knew it"
- Then the session score increments
- And the next card appears
- When I tap "I didn't know"
- Then the next card appears without incrementing score
- When I complete all cards
- Then I navigate to /results

--- US-003: Session Results ---
Title: Session results screen with score and replay
As a user, I want to see my score summary and be able to replay, so that I can track my progress.

Acceptance criteria (Gherkin):
- Given I have completed a flashcard session
- When I am on /results
- Then I see the total number of cards reviewed
- And I see the number of cards I knew
- And I see the number of cards I didn't know
- And I see a "Replay" button that restarts the session
- When I tap Replay
- Then I navigate to /session with the same theme and mode

Use the template for each file. Include `title:` frontmatter in each. Do NOT write ## Related Slices.

Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md using template .oneticket/templates/architecture.md.

Context: This is a React + Vite + TypeScript SPA with MSW + localStorage, scaffolded from AppShell.

Tech stack:
- React 18 + Vite + TypeScript
- MSW for API mocking (service worker)
- localStorage for session persistence
- React Router for navigation
- AppShell as scaffold base

Main components:
- HomeScreen (/): theme picker, learning mode selector, Start button
- FlashcardSession (/session): card display, flip animation, progress bar, scoring buttons
- SessionResults (/results): score summary, replay button
- useFlipMode hook: encapsulates flip learning algorithm (never hardcoded in components)
- useTheme hook: manages theme data loading
- useSession hook: manages session state and localStorage persistence

Data flow:
- Theme data loaded from src/data/themes/world-capitals.json via MSW mock
- Session results stored in localStorage
- Routes: /, /session, /results

AppShell adaptations:
- Navigation: keep Home, About; remove Help, Demo
- Remove DemoScreen (/demo) and HelpScreen (/help)

Constraints:
- No backend — all data mocked with MSW
- GitHub Pages deployment (static SPA)
- Learning mode logic isolated in hooks

Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/c4/system-context.md using Mermaid diagrams.

System: Flashcard App
Description: A static SPA for learning world capitals via flashcard sessions with flip mode and local scoring.

Boundaries:
- The app is a single React SPA served from GitHub Pages
- No backend — all data is local (JSON + localStorage)
- MSW mocks the theme data API

External actors:
- User: interacts with the SPA through a browser
- Browser: serves the app and stores session data in localStorage

System context: User → Flashcard App (SPA) → localStorage / MSW (mocked data)

Draw a context diagram showing:
- User at top
- Flashcard App (React SPA) in center
- localStorage (session data) on left
- MSW (theme data) on right

Use Mermaid flowchart. Include `title:` frontmatter.

Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/c4/containers.md using Mermaid diagrams.

This is a single-page React app with three routes.

Containers to document:
1. HomeContainer — renders theme picker, learning mode selector, Start button
2. SessionContainer — renders card, flip logic, progress bar, scoring buttons, uses useFlipMode hook
3. ResultsContainer — renders score summary, replay button

Data flows:
- HomeContainer → navigates to /session on Start
- SessionContainer → reads theme data via useTheme → writes session results to localStorage via useSession
- ResultsContainer → reads session results from localStorage → navigates to /session on Replay

MSW setup: service worker intercepts fetch requests for /api/themes/world-capitals and returns JSON from src/data/themes/world-capitals.json

Draw a container diagram showing the SPA as one box with three internal components and external localStorage.

Use Mermaid. Include `title:` frontmatter.

Slice name: Session — card flip and scoring

Scope:
- Implement FlashcardSession page with:
  - Progress bar (current card index / total)
  - Card component that flips on click/tap (CSS flip animation)
  - "I knew it" and "I didn't know" buttons (visible after flip)
  - Navigation to /results when session ends
- Implement useFlipMode hook that encapsulates all flip learning logic

- Structure is ready for spaced-repetition mode to be added as another hook
